owner_requirement: At most two voluntary strategic stops in the game, for player and rivals alike. Do not admit a field benefiting from5..8stops; diagnose the incentives first. This domain/game rule does not cap the generic solver's diagnostic capabilities.
plans: In each of ten existing I/II contexts, select source-best complete-GP plan at each stop count1..8 and12; also test explicit medium1lap then soft remaining laps as a fresh-static-grip sanity anchor. Keep exact car, sliders, actor, seed, environment and physical tolerances for paired comparisons. More-than-two-stop cases are offline diagnostics only, never eligible game plans.
interpretation: Ablations and quarter-slope/double-pit-cost/preparation70 controls diagnose mechanisms, not proposed physics coefficients. Every altered request is fully re-solved with thermal/energy closure, not a retimed result. Existing source-optimal plans are not guaranteed optimal under an intervention; do not claim global alternative optima. NoWearGrip retains wear accumulation/heat; NoDirectTemperatureGrip retains thermal wear effects. Joint ablation removes both direct grip mechanisms only.
checks: All unchanged controls must match source physical/diagnostic/result digests, per-lap times, final state, ledgers and metrics exactly. Verify total elapsed minus summed moving-lap times equals configured pit cost times stop count; max carry jumps, all failed outcomes and exact fresh representative repeats retained. Native only; no game/catalog/solver equations changed.
observed_accounting_before_audit: 4500 source GP results close at22seconds per stop (not generic20s default), max residual5.46e-12s. Soft legacy wear_grip_k=.6 gives12% direct grip loss at raw wear.2. Thermal-career adapter replaced wear accumulation/temperature profiles but inherited old linear wear-to-grip parameters.
